rachel: Heads-up — migration playbook PR #701 is blocked. Docs examples switched embedding model to `rwd-emb-v2` (1536 dim) but SDK snippets and a couple sample apps still instantiate embed clients assuming 768 dims. Staging smoke fails with a vector-length mismatch error when running the examples. Need quick sync: update SDK snippet, fix sample app, and schedule the model alias swap in staging.

omar: Can you paste the failing output? I can try to repro locally.

rachel: CI repro (shortened):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.staging.redwood.ai/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-emb-v2","input":"foo"}' | jq -r '.vector | length'
# returns 1536
# client-side code expects 768 -> downstream assert fails: 'expected 768, got 1536'
```

peter: Thanks — that's on me. We shipped a doc change without bumping the SDK examples in the repo. I can push a tiny patch to PR #701 replacing the 768 assumption with a runtime check and a short note: "verify embedding length using len(resp.embedding) before indexing". I'll also cut a micro release (0.12.1) with the corrected snippet.

lydia: For the staging alias flip: please avoid peak dev hours. Suggest window 01:00-03:00 UTC tonight. Also note that the routing config has a cache TTL; after we flip the alias mapping you should run a cache-bust: `curl -X PURGE https://controlplane.staging.redwood.ai/aliases` or `systemctl reload routing` depending on the node.

rachel: Good call — add a short troubleshooting paragraph in the migration guide about stale alias caches and embed-dim mismatches. Include the runtime check snippet + client fallback.

peter: Proposed SDK snippet (JS) — short-term safe patch to avoid hardcoding dims:
```
// JS client: defensive embed handling
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({model: 'rwd-emb-v2', input: 'hello'});
if (!resp.embedding || resp.embedding.length < 512) {
  throw new Error('unexpected embedding length: ' + (resp.embedding||[]).length);
}
// Proceed to index/normalize
```
Add a note: "This example tolerates changes in vector dim; prefer runtime checks and keep indexers adaptive."

omar: On the docs side I'll update the sample app (Python) to assert against the returned length instead of assuming 768. Proposed python snippet for migration guide:
```
# python: check embedding length
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='rwd-emb-v2', input='hi')
vec = resp['embedding']
if len(vec) not in (768, 1536):
    raise RuntimeError(f'unexpected embedding dim: {len(vec)}')
# adapt index settings based on len(vec)
```

devops-bot: PR #701: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/701 — smoke job failing: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/docs-smoke/701-9 (error: vector-dim-mismatch).

lydia: Once Peter cuts the micro release and Omar updates sample app, ops can schedule alias flip in the suggested window. I will run the routing cache purge and watch for errors. Please also add a short rollback plan in the migration guide (how to point back to v1 embeddings).

rachel: I'll add rollback commands to the guide: show how to revert `/etc/redwood/routes/alias-mapping.yaml` and `systemctl reload routing`. Also will include a one-line legal/data note about storage of embeddings for 90 days per retention policy.

peter: Pushed SDK patch and published 0.12.1. Updated PR #701 with new snippet and a short changelog entry.

omar: Updated sample app in the docs repo to use runtime check and adaptive indexing. Re-ran local smoke — passes now.

lydia: Scheduling the alias flip for 01:30 UTC. I'll post back when completed and run the purge.

devops-bot: Alias flip completed at 01:31 UTC. Purge run: success across control-plane nodes.

rachel: Re-ran the docs smoke in CI — job 701-12 now green: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/docs-smoke/701-12. All sample snippets validated.

peter: Minor follow-up: file a small note in the SDK changelog about embedding dimension changes being possible across model families; mention runtime checks. I'll open a tiny RFC for the SDK that surfaces embedding dim on client objects.

rachel: Great. I've merged PR #701 and added the migration guide section "Embedding model swaps: verifying vector dims and indexer adjustments". Closing thread — ping me if anyone spots broken sample code in examples repo. :white_check_mark:
